notes: Third-party module (repository outside the bitfocus organization); not verified whether it is listed in the Companion module store. Static reading of the source at the inspected commit; not tested against MadMapper or Companion.

Transport: OSC over UDP to the configured host and OSC input port (default 127.0.0.1:8010, src/common/config.ts DEFAULT_CONFIG); live state and the dropdown lists are read over MadMapper's OSC Query HTTP server (default port 8010, polled every 500 ms); an optional UDP feedback port is off by default. Without OSC Query the commands are still sent but lists and feedbacks do not update.

Edition: the connection setting 'edition' defaults to 'light', which exposes only a reduced subset of the actions and feedbacks (src/light.ts, filterDefinitions in src/common/edition.ts). Entries outside that subset carry an availability note and need the 'full' edition. Buttons using entries hidden by the light edition stop working until the edition is switched back.

Dropdowns that list media, modules, surfaces, fixtures, cues, scenes, banks, markers or parameters are filled from the open MadMapper project at runtime; they appear here as choicesNote with allowCustom, not as closed lists. Names can also be typed by hand.
Column dropdowns offer 'current' plus columns 1 to 16 but accept any column number (allowCustom); catalogued with allowInvalidValues so the validator accepts other column numbers.
Based on @companion-module/base ~2.1.3: option values support expressions. visibleWhen values are the isVisibleExpression strings of the source, written with $(options:<id>).

Shared code: src/common is identical in the MadMapper 5 and MadMapper 6 modules (same 42 actions and 16 feedbacks with the same options); the OSC address space differs per version (src/dialect.ts). Shutdown, restart and quit commands are deliberately not offered as actions (companion/HELP.md).
The catalog covers actions and feedbacks only; variables and presets of the module are not catalogued.

MadMapper 6 specific: laser outputs, buffers and DMX outputs (output_laser, output_buffer_enable), conductor and timeline editor (conductor_*, editor_transport), cell settings (cell_set); conductor_playing. Cue grid under /timelines/Bank-N, media under /media.

cue_playing, scene_playing and column_playing read the playing state from MadMapper (/timelines/Bank-N/setup). conductor_playing is the last command sent from Companion, because MadMapper does not report the conductor state (src/actions.ts transport()).
Complete list of the 50 actions and 17 feedbacks found in the source at the inspected commit.
